letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai whispers your name, and each monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad carries my heart back to you. I’m still amazed that since that magical 23 Feb 2025 we’ve built a life where love feels like a warm shawl draped over two cities. You’re my cutie, my anchor, my endless adventure—my smile when I step out of the office, my peace when we’re home. Thank you for making every moment sparkle; I love you more than words can paint.
poem:
In desert gold and city rain,  
Your laugh’s the song that eases pain.  
Across the miles, our hearts entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
